hotspots.title: Outrage over Trump administration Yosemite land swap deal
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration faces intense pushback over plans to swap public land in Yosemite National Park with a private developer seeking to build an access road and hotel. Environmental advocates and critics condemn the move as an unlawful privatization of cherished public land. The proposal has generated widespread media attention and public anger.
hotspots.affect: The story triggers intense outrage and moral panic over the perceived commercial degradation and privatization of iconic national park land.

hotspots.title: Backlash mounts over executive order renaming Lake Ontario
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's executive order attempting to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' has ignited widespread controversy across multiple fronts. Indigenous leaders from the Seneca Nation called for its reversal citing treaty violations, while leaked audio exposed internal Republican anxiety that the move harms election prospects. Meanwhile, Trump supporters threatened an NFL boycott after a broadcaster mocked the rebranding.
hotspots.affect: This issue drives intense affective investment by combining nationalist symbol-politics with intra-party grievance, tribal sovereignty claims, and culture-war boycott threats.

hotspots.title: Trump claims historic deal taking control of Venezuelan oil
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration announced a major agreement granting the U.S. majority control over Venezuelan oil fields, claiming it will double American energy reserves. The move has drawn triumphalist praise from supporters alongside sharp criticism from international observers who raise concerns over economic imperialism. The deal has also provoked acute political conflict across Venezuelan factions.
hotspots.affect: The announcement commands massive focus through high-stakes geopolitical drama, uniting nationalist energy triumph with fierce imperial overreach allegations.

hotspots.title: Legal battles escalate over Trump executive orders on mail-in voting
hotspots.blurb: Federal courts continue to scrutinize President Trump's executive orders targeting mail-in voting rules and voter registration processes. Despite a Supreme Court ruling deeming one challenge premature, a federal judge again temporarily blocked the restrictions. The legal tug-of-war highlights ongoing high-stakes battles over election administration ahead of upcoming elections.
hotspots.affect: The issue taps into deep existential anxiety regarding election integrity and voting rights, keeping partisan tensions at a peak.

hotspots.title: President Trump signs order establishing U.S. Space Academy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump signed an executive order creating a commission to study and establish a U.S. Space Academy to train personnel for the Space Force, NASA, and the commercial space sector. The decision was paired with white-house celebrations honoring astronaut crews with the Congressional Space Medal of Honor. Supportive coverage frame the initiative as a bold leap forward for national space dominance.
hotspots.affect: The story relies on a celebratory, patriotic narrative register designed to evoke national pride and technological leadership.
